value_semantics: Exact project inputs, including an explicitly typed NIS probability when supported; validated and resolved by the selected plugin into float32 or int32 for generation. No guessed unit conversion.
identity: Exact selected plugin ID, implementation version, manifest SHA-256 and parameter-schema identity required before applying
shared_parameters: Apply through the existing shared_key authority, then resolve every selected owner transactionally
scope: Parameters only. No hardware, task process, firmware code, runtime loading or TreeDiagram compatibility is implied.
